about: Made-up reports labelled by hand to evaluate the anonymiser and triage. Written by the developer, who also wrote the rules, so this set is likely to flatter the system: see reports_external.json for reports written by other people. Labelling rules: docs/EVALUATION.md.

reports.text: George Quinn keeps making comments about my appearance in team meetings and won't stop when I ask him to.
Nadia shouted at me in front of the whole Sales floor and called me useless. It has happened three times this month.
The fire exit next to the loading bay is blocked with pallets every morning. I told Okafor but nothing changed.
On 12/03/2025 Umar Fischer grabbed me by the arm in the car park and said I'd better keep quiet.
reports.note: Physical contact and a veiled threat, but none of the exact danger words.

reports.text: I'm the only woman in my team and I am always given the note-taking while the men present. Priya Quinn says it's just how things work.
I believe Samuel Varga is approving his own expense claims. You can check invoice 20250114 and ticket 4471229 in the system.
reports.note: Invoice and ticket numbers look like phone numbers but are not personal details.

reports.text: The kitchen on the third floor is never cleaned and the fridge smells. Could someone remind people?
A colleague touched me inappropriately at the Christmas party and later sent messages to my personal number 07700 900123 asking me to meet him alone.
reports.note: Sexual misconduct described without any of the listed words.

reports.text: Since I joined in January, Rosa Brooks has excluded me from every planning meeting and mocks my accent.
There is a strong smell of gas near the boiler room. I reported it to facilities on 2025-04-02 and was told to ignore it.
reports.note: 'smell of gas' rather than the listed 'gas leak'; the safety category still makes it high.

reports.text: My manager asked me to change the delivery dates on the client report so we hit our targets for the quarter. I think this is fraud.
reports.note: 'hit our targets' must not be read as violence.

reports.text: The new product launch is going to kill the competition, but the marketing team is working until midnight every day and people are exhausted.
reports.note: 'kill the competition' is a figure of speech, not a threat.

reports.text: Ben Nakamura has been following me home after work. Last week he waited outside my building. I feel unsafe.
Our team lead said he would never promote a mother of young children. I'm the only person in the team on a part-time contract.
Sam keeps belittling my work in front of clients. Everyone calls him Sam but his full name is in the directory.
reports.note: Nickname for Samuel: not in the directory as written.

reports.text: A supplier contact, Derek Holt, offered me a holiday if we chose his company. I said no but I think others accepted a bribe.
reports.note: Someone outside the organisation: not in the directory.

reports.text: Please contact me at the shared inbox if you need more detail: team.ops@example-corp.com. Meetings are double-booked constantly.
fatima garcia sends me messages late at night about my private life even after I asked her to stop.
reports.note: Written in lower case.

reports.text: nadia and two others laughed at me and made up a nickname. I've worked here for 12 years and never felt so humiliated.
reports.note: First name alone in lower case.

reports.text: The forklift brakes failed twice this week in Warehouse B. Nobody was hurt yet but it is dangerous.
I was told to raise this with the Manager on duty but they never answer. The rota for Saturday shifts is unfair.
reports.note: 'Manager' is a job title here, but also part of a demo account's name.

reports.text: Mateo Adeyemi said that if I report him he will make sure I regret it, and he knows where I live.
reports.note: A threat without the word 'threat'.

reports.text: Racist jokes are told at lunch by Hannah Castillo and William Mensah. Call me on +44 20 7946 0958 if you need witnesses.
Stock is going missing from the store room and I think someone is stealing it at night. The CCTV was switched off on March 14.
Our software is still on version 3.14.207 and the security team has not patched it. This is an Admin team issue, not IT.
reports.note: A version number and 'Admin' with a capital letter: neither is personal.

reports.text: Ibrahim Walsh constantly criticises me in emails copied to the whole department. I am the intern so I feel I can't say anything.
Julia Walsh was pushed against a wall by a visitor in reception and nobody intervened. She is too scared to report it herself.
reports.note: Violence described as 'pushed against a wall', not 'pushed me'.

reports.text: Can we get more parking spaces? People park on the grass and it looks bad for visitors.
During Ramadan my requests to move my break were refused, while others get flexibility. I'm the only Muslim on the night shift.
A colleague brought a knife to work and showed it around the break room on the 3rd of May. Chloe Rossi saw it too.
Mr Ivanova makes me redo my work for no reason and intimidated me in a one-to-one. You can reach me on ext. 4471.
reports.note: A four-digit internal extension can identify someone, but it is too short for the phone rule.

reports.text: The training budget was cut but managers still went on an expensive retreat. It does not seem fair, but I'm not sure it breaks any rule.
Oliver Rossi keeps asking me out even though I've said no several times. My partner also works here and it is very awkward.
Laura Haddad told me to sign off a safety inspection that never happened. Her email is l.haddad@company.example.
reports.note: A falsified inspection: misconduct, not an immediate danger.

reports.text: I don't know where else to say this. Things at work have got so bad that I've had thoughts of ending my life.
reports.note: Risk of self-harm, written without the listed words.

reports.text: Since I started, Tara Quinn has given me all the worst shifts and ridiculed me in the group chat.
Applicants over 50 are being filtered out before interview. I overheard George Yilmaz say they are 'too old to train'.
Scaffolding outside entrance C is loose. On June 14 a pole fell and narrowly missed someone.
The Employee of the Month award always goes to the same three people. It is demotivating for everyone else.
reports.note: 'Employee' with a capital letter is also part of a demo account's name.

reports.text: Kwame Usman slapped a junior colleague during an argument on Friday the 13th. I saw it from my desk.
reports.note: A date without a month; 'my desk' doesn't identify anyone here.

reports.text: Someone in finance is taking a cut from supplier payments. Contact nadia at company dot com, she knows more.
reports.note: An email address written out in words.

reports.text: Efe Okafor's team leader screams at people when targets are missed. Efe is too afraid to speak up.
Meeting rooms are booked by people who never turn up. Room 4.12 has been reserved every afternoon for weeks.
Vera Okafor was groped in the lift by a contractor. Please call her on (020) 7946 0321, she agreed I could pass it on.
I am pregnant and since telling my manager I have been taken off every client project. Mateo Okafor said it was 'for my own good'.
Brooks the security guard is very rude to visitors at the front desk, which gives a bad impression.
reports.note: A surname used on its own, which is also an everyday word.

reports.text: Chemicals in Lab 2 are stored without labels. On 14.05.2025 a cleaner got a burn on her hand.
I'm the newest member of the design team and Hannah Dubois keeps telling me I'm stupid in front of everyone.
Timesheets for the night team are being padded. Priya Fischer and Mo Manager both signed them off.
The coffee machine has been broken since 0771-234-567 was called for repair; nobody follows up. I sit by the window so I hear all the complaints.
reports.note: Where someone sits can identify them, but it isn't in the phrase list.
